clips.title: The story
paras: Thunderhorn Water Well is a vital water source situated in the rolling plains of central Mulgore along the path between Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff. Like all the wells across the valley, it provides essential nourishment to the tribes and the herds roaming the grasslands. Keeping this water clean and defended is crucial to maintaining life in the tauren homeland.

Situated amid the sprawling grasslands of central Mulgore, the Thunderhorn Water Well taps directly into the pure aquifers feeding the valley. For the nomadic tauren and their newly settled villages, these communal wells represent life, sustenance, and the Earth Mother's bounty. Because water is precious across the sun-drenched plains, controlling the wells means controlling the land itself. Intruders such as the Venture Company have repeatedly eyed these sources, attempting to harness them for industrial exploitation and disrupt the fragile balance the tribes fight to preserve.
